query:
-- Delegates who have a meeting in Slot 8 (11:00) but NOT in Slot 7 (10:30)
SELECT 
  dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  s.companyName as slot8Sponsor
FROM meetings m8
JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON dp.attendeeId = m8.attendeeId
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m8.sponsorId
WHERE m8.timeSlot = 8
  AND m8.attendeeId NOT IN (
    SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 7
  )
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
